title: Police Knew He Was Hiding Something (Uncut)
description:
On April 15th, 2023, an officer noticed a speeding vehicle and conducted a traffic stop. Upon speaking with the driver, he discovered that the driver didn't have valid documents or a driver's license. At this point, he was unaware of the deadly weapons in the driver's car. The driver picked up a charge here for not informing the officer about the weapon he was carrying. Things were only going to get worse for him from here. While the driver was busy explaining his business to the cops, one of the officers quickly ran a background check on him. He was in for a lot of trouble now.
The man had realized by now that he had accumulated several charges, and there was no escape for him at this point. He was trying to excuse his way out of the situation but the officers had one more blow to deliver. The driver’s wife called and tried to explain the insurance details to the officers but they were not convinced. As soon as the officers got the man inside the police car, they searched his vehicle and found his guns. The male already had an in-state warrant and was additionally charged with aggravated unlawful use of a weapon, unlawful use of a weapon, obstructing justice, speeding, an invalid driver’s license, and operation of an uninsured motor vehicle.

About Us / Disclaimer: 

Police Insider provides unbiased and authentic footage of incidents captured on body cams. We believe this footage can be used as an educational guide for viewers. 

We only provide unique and original content that hasn’t been covered before on YouTube.

The raw footage for the videos on this channel have been obtained directly from the respective Police Departments. We as a media company have the right to use it commercially. Most incidents may require a fee associated with the request and take several days to process.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
